title: Rate against concentration for each order
caption: Zero order: the rate does not change with [A]. First order: rate ∝ [A], a straight line through the origin. Second order: rate ∝ [A]², a curve, so doubling [A] quadruples the rate.
alt: Rate against [A]: a horizontal line (zero order), a straight line through the origin (first), and an upward curve (second).
description: First order: rate doubles when [A] doubles.

checks.name: first order: doubling [A] from 0.8 to 1.6 doubles the rate
second order: doubling [A] from 0.8 (0.32) to 1.6 (1.28) quadruples the rate
